label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (ssrf) alert-TP: User input 'param' flows directly to 'endpoint' variable, which is used in the URL sink at line 24. The mitigation check 'octets[0] == 127' only blocks loopback addresses, failing to prevent access to private/internal IPs (e.g., 192.168.x.x, 10.x.x.x) that satisfy the condition '!= 127'. An attacker can supply such an IP to trigger the outbound fetch.

evidence.note: User input 'param' assigned to 'endpoint', checked against loopback, then used in URL sink.
